text:
maria: heads up — new quantized bring-up (q4b-int8) for model-x landed in staging and the initial bench flagged higher failure rates on our longform prompt bank :eyes:

kai: can you share the specific failure mode? hallucination rate, tokenization mismatches, or logits collapse?

maria: primarily hallucination/regression on multi-paragraph prompts. also noticed a ~12% decrease on exact-match for the golden QA pairs. linking bench run: https://redwood.internal/qbench/1747777777

ash? i think dedupe overlap might be masking some edge anchors. ash: label ops — we have ~1.2k golden candidates that could be affected but the relabel queue is full. we can only do a micro-relabel of ~400/week without extra contractor help.

kai: suspect dedupe threshold too permissive for paraphrase variants. ran a quick fingerprint diff, seeing many near-duplicates with low token overlap but semantically different. propose running a semantic-sim check at 0.88 and surface the top-500 ambiguous pairs for relabeling.

maria: ok can we do a small experiment first? plan: 1) run semantic dedupe at 0.88 on the current golden set + staging samplebank 2) take top-500 ambiguous -> manual relabel 3) re-run q4b-int8 bench on that filtered golden and compare with fp32 baseline. if regressions go away, broaden.

ash: i kicked off the semantic diff job, ETA ~25m. query I used (postgrest):

```sql
-- seed for ambiguous pairs (cosine embedding similarity, descending)
SELECT s.id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim
FROM staging.samplebank s
JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE sim > 0.88 AND sim < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

ash: also added a label job: labelops_bot created job #LAB-1747 for 500 items and assigned to sam + 2 contractors. labelops_bot: "job LAB-1747 created, ETA 48h"

labelops_bot: job LAB-1747 status: queued -> in_progress

sam: will triage the top-100 this afternoon, focusing on multi-paragraph QAs and code blocks. any special instructions for relabelers?

maria: yes — relabelers should mark: (a) exact-answer change, (b) hallucinated extra facts, (c) truncation artifacts. use the relabel form and tag with #quant4b-regress so we can filter easily.

kai: once we have relabel results, i'll run two bench passes: fp32 baseline and q4b-int8 (same seed, same beam). output metrics to snapshot: latency, perplexity, EM, hallucination-rate. If delta EM < 1.5% and hallucination drops, proceed with canary rollout to 5% traffic.

maria: timeline: semantic diff job finishes ~1747777802, labelers start 1747777810, expect first relabel batch done by 1747778200. kai/ash — can you both set an alert in the console to catch any new regression >2% after canary?

ash: created console alert "quant4b-golden-regress" with threshold 2% EM delta and webhook to #eng-runtime.

maria: perfect. small note — also saw a tokenizer mismatch on a handful of samples where punctuation normalization changed answer spans. i added a quick normalizer to the preprocess pipeline in staging (PR #1189).

sam: confirmed, first 100 relabels pulled. will report ambiguous cases as threads here.

maria: thanks team. if relabel shows systemic changes we may need to expand golden and update eval harness. otherwise microfix + canary is the path. :shipit:

kai: ping me when the relabel CSV is ready, i'll schedule bench rerun.

labelops_bot: job LAB-1747 update: 100/500 completed (20%).
